findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors
findings.proposition: The English sub-heading says the C: LIBRARY does not appear as an option in the manual package-install dialogue; the Portuguese says the PACKAGE ("o pacote") does not appear.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader scanning the troubleshooting list for the symptom "my C: library is missing from the install drop-down" will not recognise this entry, and may instead believe the problem is a missing package, so they never apply the administrator-mode fix that follows.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors
findings.proposition: The English says to right-click "This PC" in the RIGHT hand pane of the Windows file manager; the Portuguese says the LEFT pane ("no painel a esquerda").
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader following the mapped-drive procedure looks in the wrong pane of Windows Explorer for "This PC" and may conclude the entry is absent.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors
findings.proposition: The Portuguese adds the hedge "(ou direita, dependendo da sua configuracao)" - that the pane position depends on the reader's configuration - which the English does not state.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader is told the interface location is configuration-dependent, which makes the step less definite than the English and gives no way to tell which case applies.
